def peekn(seq, n):
    """Retrieve first n elements of a sequence without consuming them.

    Returns a tuple of the first n items and an iterable equivalent to the
    original, still having the items retrieved.

    Raises StopIteration if the sequence contains fewer than n items.
    """
    iterator = iter(seq)
    items = []
    for _ in range(n):
        items.append(next(iterator))
    return items, itertools.chain(items, iterator)
